annotation.title_clean: Navigating the sociotechnical labyrinth: Dynamic certification for responsible embodied AI
annotation.title_en: Navigating the sociotechnical labyrinth: Dynamic certification for responsible embodied AI
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Bakirtzis, G.; Aler Tubella, A.; Theodorou, A.; Danks, D.; Topcu, U.
annotation.summary_en: Book-chapter preprint proposing dynamic certification, an adaptive regulatory approach for embodied AI. Certified operational envelopes expand or contract based on evidence from staged testing (early-stage simulation, transitional, confirmatory). Illustrated with an urban delivery robot and drones, it also sets out open technical, sociotechnical and regulatory research problems.
key_provisions_or_claims: Static one-time certification is inadequate for learning, adaptive embodied AI systems.
Dynamic certification incrementally expands or revokes a system's operational envelope based on monitored performance.
Staged process: formal models, simulation, transitional testing in controlled settings, confirmatory real-world testing.
Illustrated with an urban delivery robot and an autonomous drone certified first for limited contexts.
Open problems: model-based design, multidisciplinary teams, and AI-tailored standards and testing regimes.
